title: Penalties
description: Violations recorded against employees. Each goes to the stage head of the stage where it happened, then to HR; only penalties HR approves count toward repeats and payroll.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Employee name or code, like EMP-0012

list.emptyBody: Penalties recorded for this month show up here.
list.noResultsBody: Try another name, or clear the filters.
list.profileEmptyBody: Penalties recorded for this employee show up here, newest first.

approve.title: Approve this penalty?
approve.body: {name} · {violation} · {action}. HR's approval fixes the level and the deduction.
approve.recountRefreshed: The list below is up to date now. Check it and confirm again.

recount.label: Approved penalties this changes

heading.zero: Approving this will raise the level of approved penalties:
heading.one: Approving this will raise the level of 1 approved penalty:
heading.two: Approving this will raise the level of 2 approved penalties:
heading.few: Approving this will raise the level of {count} approved penalties:
heading.many: Approving this will raise the level of {count} approved penalties:
heading.other: Approving this will raise the level of {count} approved penalties:

recount.recordNote: Recording changes nothing: they change only when this penalty is approved.
recount.approveNote: It was recorded with an earlier date than these, so they move up one level each.

cancel.title: Cancel this penalty?
cancel.body: {name} · {violation}. The penalty is kept with your reason and no longer counts.

form.title: Record a penalty
form.description: It goes to the stage head of the stage where it happened, then to HR. The level comes from the employee's approved penalties for the same violation, in every stage.
form.employeeSearch: Type a name (English or Arabic) or code
form.noEmployeeMatches: No active employee matches that search.
form.noEmployees: No active employees. Add one from the Employees screen.
form.violationSearch: Type a violation or group (English or Arabic)
form.noViolationMatches: No violation in use matches that search.
form.noViolations: No violations in use. Add them in Settings → Penalty catalogue.
form.saveFailed: The penalty couldn't be saved. Try again.
form.futureDate: The date can't be in the future.
form.stageHint: This employee works in several stages. That stage's head reviews it; the other stages' heads don't see it.
form.startsReview: It goes to the stage head of {stage} first, then to HR.

startsHr.EMPLOYEE_IS_HEAD: It goes straight to HR: the employee heads this stage.
startsHr.RECORDER_IS_HEAD: It goes straight to HR: you review this stage's penalties, so your recording is the stage review.
startsHr.NO_STAGE_HEAD: It goes straight to HR: {stage} has no stage head.

preview.label: What this penalty means
preview.idle: Choose the employee, violation and date to see the level and action.
preview.priorNone: No earlier approved penalty for this violation in the repetition window.
preview.priorOne: 1 earlier approved penalty for this violation in the repetition window.

priorMany.zero: {count} earlier approved penalties for this violation in the repetition window.
priorMany.one: {count} earlier approved penalty for this violation in the repetition window.
priorMany.two: {count} earlier approved penalties for this violation in the repetition window.
priorMany.few: {count} earlier approved penalties for this violation in the repetition window.
priorMany.many: {count} earlier approved penalties for this violation in the repetition window.
priorMany.other: {count} earlier approved penalties for this violation in the repetition window.

preview.failed: The level couldn't be worked out.

approve.title: Approve at the stage review?
approve.body: {name} · {violation} · {stage}. It goes to HR next; HR fixes the level and the deduction.
approve.done: Penalty approved and sent to HR.

reject.title: Reject this penalty?
reject.body: {name} · {violation}. It is kept with your reason, never counts, and whoever recorded it is told.
reject.reasonPlaceholder: He was on an official task that day

steps.title: Steps
steps.reviewed: Approved at the stage review by {name}

skip.EMPLOYEE_IS_HEAD: No stage review: the employee heads this stage
skip.RECORDER_IS_HEAD: No stage review: recorded by someone who reviews this stage
skip.NO_STAGE_HEAD: No stage review: this stage has no stage head

steps.rejectedREVIEW: Rejected at the stage review by {name}
steps.waitingReview: Waiting for the stage head of {stage}

hrMayDecide: {stage} has no stage head now: HR can approve or reject it directly.
